svg.text: The Three RAG Generation Failure Modes
High retrieval recall does not guarantee faithful model generation:
• Hallucination: Blends retrieved facts with unverified training memory.
• Context Ignorance: Completely ignores retrieved context chunks due to
overwhelming parametric bias or long-context saturation mechanics.
• Miscalibrated Confidence: Hedges or asserts facts with faulty certainty.
System Prompt Guardrails & Anchoring
Explicit instructions force the model to anchor onto retrieved evidence:
"Base every factual claim strictly on provided excerpts."
"If text is missing, output: 'The documentation does not address [X]'"
• Strict Grounding: Converts assistant into a zero-compromise lookup tool,
favoring direct verbatim citations over loose creative synthesis.
Token-Level Logprob Inspection
Catches transitions where model drifts away from context into raw guesses:
Heuristic: logprob score less than threshold (e.g., -2.0)
• Signal: Sudden drop in confidence indicates high likelihood of interpolation.
• Parsing: Runs custom spans wrapping tokens in error tags, providing an
automated audit trail for live human-in-the-loop filtering layers.
Claim Extraction & Post-Evaluation
The algorithmic backbone of RAG validation frameworks (e.g., RAGAS):
Pipeline: Text Output -> Extract Atomic Claims -> Run N-Cross Check
• Mapping: Validates each isolated fact against the source context.
Verdicts: SUPPORTED | CONTRADICTED | NOT_ADDRESSED
Score calculation: Total Supported Claims divided by Total Extracted Claims
Adaptive Retrieval: Self-RAG vs. FLARE
Interleaves search discovery dynamically directly inside generation runs:
• Self-RAG: Utilizes custom fine-tuned reflection tokens emitted on the fly
[Retrieve] to trigger search | [IsSup] to validate grounding inline
• FLARE: Tracks frozen model confidence intervals; pauses execution and
runs active retrieval query updates using the unverified sentence target.
Context Insufficiency & Production Logging
• The Structural Fallback Pattern: Force graceful refusal over guessing.
"Excerpts do not address [X] but do cover [Y] on Page 2."
• Debug Logging Array: Store Query, Chunks, Context Maps, and raw Logprobs.
• Consistency Sampling: Sample multi-turn text chains at nonzero temperature;
high variations across runs signal immediate grounding exposure gaps.
